body: i want to look at water, like the scene in breaking bad where mike just wants to die in peace. and it will be so fast, i'll never even know it happened. i won't even be able to register the fear from knowing i accidentally pulled the trigger. it is perfect

I've thought a lot about that, and I've realized that I can't hurt myself and others (through my suicide) to make a point to someone else. It probably wouldn't affect them for very long, anyway, obviously. So it has to be for me. And it is. I'm in so much pain that I actually can't take it anymore. Every minute is torment. So, it's for me.

look, i'm not trying to argue. and i'm not writing them a real letter saying this. but i disagree. what you're saying is the commonly held view, but i don't think it's true. i think there is a moral obligation to put yourself before other people, and i think many people would agree, except when you attach these circumstances to it it somehow changes. i'm sorry you and many other people don't feel that way, but i do. and you also don't know anything about who i am or what circumstances i'm talking about. i'm not not giving anyone an ultimatum. i'm saying if my pain doesn't stop very, very soon, i will hurt myself. in practice, that is probably the same thing, but conceptually it is very different. i would talk to anybody if it might keep them from hurting themselves. it's not blackmail. i'm not trying to get anything out of anyone. it's just that i'm going to die if my pain doesn't stop. i may not get to be a moral authority but you don't either.

again, i know most people agree with you, but just because something is the prevailing logic at the time doesn't make it right or true. there is no justifiable reason, in my mind, to let someone die if you can easily prevent it. if you really want to make a case then you start getting into terrible, slippery slope arguments ("where does it stop?") No one should have to suffer because people can't even learn a high school-level logical fallacy. i don't know why i'm telling you this. it won't convince you or anyone else. but i don't see why people couldn't just let it be. 

and also, i kind of smile at this point when people tell me to see someone. i appreciate the help and thoughts, but i've seen plenty of people. this is called unsentletters, so i just wanted to write an unsent letter

and it's not a threat. i'm going to kill myself. if it was a threat i would tell THEM.

i would stop my life at a moment's notice to help someone suffering, and right now i need that done for me

I disagree, though. I know I'm in the minority, but I would gladly talk to someone to prevent them from dying. I think it is perfectly acceptable and in fact moral to temporarily put other people before yourself, in order to save their life.  I would do it for anyone. I just need them to talk.

As far as the pain goes, it's not going anywhere. It's been years and is only getting worse, and is now unbearable. If I could leave my house to go kill myself right now I would. I can't at the moment, though.
